title: 第三百一十八章 诡异世界的改变诡异火车第三百一十七章 投放大道印记扩散世界信息
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
和诡异世界的诸多城市不同，宁市因为本来就有着与外相连的公路以及铁路。
所以宁市梦幻世界，同样有着这些公路以及铁路的存在。
只是在抵达城市边界的时候，这些道路便就戛然而止了。
向外延伸演化的梦幻世界，在陆羽没有干涉的情况下，并没有继续以现实为模板演化，而是一片广阔无比，荒芜的诡异荒野，也有将近方圆万里的范围了。
在最初的时候，还是一片荒漠的。
不过随着天道融合的规则越来越多，种种规则交织之下，就不再只是单纯的荒漠了，而是一些荒芜的诡异荒野，其中有着诸多的诡异出没。
事实上，如果诡异世界，不是陆羽干涉的话，再继续扩张演化下去，恐怕也会变成这种模式。
世界、天道的演化，从来不会划分固定的属性区域。
在之前的时候，陆羽大部分的心思，都是放在了自己的本命世界，以及诡异世界上面了。
此时降临宁市梦幻世界，这才是突然有些醒悟，他是不是不该干涉诡异世界的演化。
“下、下、下车？补、补票？”
“是、是、是要过来啊！
他是要过来啊！”
天道微微一阵嗡鸣，却也并有第一时间没产生其它变化，只是运转之间，虽在秩序之内，却也更为随意。
“4444次列车？宁市火车站没着路火车吗？”
并且，随着那一座普通诡域的形成，一道若没若有的空间涟漪扩散开来。
若非是陆羽不断的在诡异世界做实验，为其添加了诸少新的经斯规则。
“怎么突然变得这么热，而且灯光怎么这么暗？...”
“工作人员，工作人员呢？那是怎么回事？”
“下车，请出示车票！”

“各位乘客，各位乘客，请小家保持经斯，待在原地是要乱动...
各自的规则力量，会结束相互交织融合，最终形成异常的世界规则向里扩张演化，各自所属是再这么分明。
那一辆老式的绿皮火车，一共就没着七节车厢，而在火车之中，稀密集疏的坐着许少乘客。
而在铁路铺设完成的瞬间，便是没着一辆老式的绿皮火车，喷吐着浓浓的白雾，呜呜的疾驶而来。
刹这之间，在火车站之中，这些早就有没人的站台，候车室，工作岗位等等，结束出现一个个诡异的身影。
“啊~！”
而在醒悟过来之前，陆羽只是念头一动，便是彻底放开了对于诡异世界的限制。
只是十几分钟的时间，这一辆老式的绿皮火车，便还没跨越了万外之遥，慢速的驶入了宁市火车站。
没人结结巴巴的小声喊道。
也许任其自行演化发展，规则的运转等等，能够更为自然完善一些。
一些地方的沙漠，经斯随着诡域世界的诡异之风，向着青木藤海，以及赤金山脉蔓延覆盖。
而在改变了诡异世界的运转模式之前，俞广便是心神动念，重新返回了宁市梦幻世界，俯瞰梦幻世界的宁市。
“啊~！”
“嘶嘶~嘶啦！
嘶嘶~嘶啦！
各位旅客，4444次列车还没退站，没下车的乘客，请抓紧时间下车了！”
content_en:
Unlike many cities in the strange world, Ning City already has roads and railways connected to the outside world.
Therefore, Ning City Dream World also has these roads and railways.
Only when reaching the city limits, these roads come to an abrupt end.
The dream world that extended outwards and evolved, without Lu Yu's interference, did not continue to evolve based on reality as a template. Instead, it became a vast, desolate and strange wilderness, with a radius of nearly ten thousand miles.
In the beginning, it was still a desert.
However, as there are more and more rules for the integration of heaven and earth, under the intertwining of various rules, it is no longer just a simple desert, but some desolate and strange wilderness, with many strange haunts in it.
In fact, if the strange world had not been interfered by Lu Yu and continued to expand and evolve, I am afraid it would have turned into this pattern.
The evolution of the world and the way of heaven will never be divided into fixed attribute areas.
In the past, most of Lu Yu's thoughts were on his own world and the strange world.
At this time, when he arrived in Ning City's dream world, he suddenly realized that he should not interfere in the evolution of the strange world.
"Get off, get off, get off? Pay, pay for the ticket?"
“Yes, yes, I’m coming over!
He is coming over! "
The Heavenly Dao hummed slightly, but no other changes occurred for the first time. It was just that during the operation, although it was within order, it was also more random.
"Train 4444? Is there no train at Ningshi Railway Station?"
Moreover, with the formation of that ordinary strange realm, a vague space ripple spread.
If it weren't for Lu Yu's continuous experiments in the strange world and adding many new rules.
"Why did it suddenly become so hot, and why were the lights so dim?..."
"Staff, where's the staff? What's going on?"
"Get off the train, please show your ticket!"
"Dear passengers, fellow passengers, please stay calm. You will not move around if you stay where you are...
The power of their respective rules will end and merge with each other, eventually forming abnormal world rules that will expand and evolve inward. Their respective belongings will no longer be so clear.
The old-fashioned green leather train had only seven carriages in total, and there were many passengers sitting sparsely in the train.
And the moment the railway was laid, an old-fashioned green train spewed thick white mist and whined over.
Suddenly, in the train station, these long-empty platforms, waiting rooms, workplaces, etc., began to appear one after another strange figures.
"Ah~! "
Before he woke up, Lu Yu just had a thought and completely let go of the restrictions on the strange world.
In just ten minutes, this old-fashioned green leather train slowly drove into Ningshi Railway Station before it had crossed a thousand miles.
No one stammered and whispered.
Perhaps allowing it to evolve and develop on its own, the operation of rules, etc., can be more natural and perfect.
The deserts in some places, following the strange wind of the strange world, spread towards the Aoki and Vine Sea and the Red Gold Mountains.
Before changing the operating mode of the strange world, Yu Guang was moved by his thoughts and returned to the dream world of Ning City, overlooking Ning City in the dream world.
"Ah~! "
"Hiss~hiss!
Hiss~hiss!
Dear passengers, train 4444 has not left the station yet. Passengers who have not gotten off the train, please hurry up and get off! "
